Fundamentally different from VolReg (direction-specific vol vs total vol level) and SampEn (distributional asymmetry vs time-series regularity).

Volume on MEXC 4H bars doesn't reliably proxy real liquidity — wash trading, market maker activity, and aggregated exchange volume distort the signal.

rejected.name: Regime Persistence: HH/LL Streaks
rejected.reason: 15,552 configs. 81 healthy, 0 perm-sig. Higher-high / lower-low streak counting provides no edge. Sequential extremes are already embedded in EMA crossover signals.

rejected.name: Regime Persistence: ReturnConsistency
rejected.reason: 15,959 configs. 1,006 healthy, 6 perm-sig (ALL SUI, identical core signal with SL/TP variants). IS 0.54 → OOS 2.95, p=0.010. SUI-only = known OOS trend bias. max_hold inert across all 6 configs (same OOS metrics regardless of max_hold). Rejected as SUI-specific artifact.

rejected.name: Realized Skewness
rejected.reason: 720 configs (of 1,440 skew+kurt). 100 healthy (81 SUI, 19 SOL) but 0 perm-sig. Return distribution asymmetry does not predict direction at 4H. Skewness is a risk metric, not an alpha generator — it tells you HOW returns are distributed but not WHERE they're going.

rejected.name: Realized Kurtosis
rejected.reason: 720 configs. 156 healthy (139 SUI, 7 DOGE, 6 SOL, 4 AVAX) but 0 perm-sig. Tail thickness doesn't predict direction. SUI dominance (89%) reflects known OOS trend bias. Same conclusion as skewness: distributional shape is descriptive, not predictive.

rejected.name: Order Flow Imbalance (OHLCV proxy)
rejected.reason: 4,320 configs. 0 healthy. Buy/sell pressure from candlestick structure (close-low vs high-close) has no predictive power at 4H. True order flow requires tick-level data; OHLCV proxies are too noisy. Volume-weighted version also failed.

rejected.name: Z-Score Mean Reversion / Momentum
rejected.reason: 2,400 configs. 0 healthy. Both reversal mode (fade extremes) and momentum mode (follow extremes with EMA confirmation) failed. Price z-score is essentially a band indicator (Bollinger) — well-known to not produce alpha after costs in crypto.

rejected.name: Fractal Dimension (Katz FD)
rejected.reason: 1,728 configs. 14 healthy (12 SUI, 2 SOL). 0 perm-sig. Katz FD oscillates too rapidly at 4H to be a reliable complexity measure. Low FD (smooth) periods don't predict breakout direction.

rejected.name: Detrended Price Oscillator (DPO)
rejected.reason: 1,728 configs. 142 healthy (107 SUI, 30 SOL, 5 DOGE). 0 perm-sig. DPO removes trend via shifted SMA, but the detrended cycle has no predictive power. SUI 75% dominant = known OOS bias.

rejected.name: ROC Regime (Momentum consolidation)
rejected.reason: 5,184 configs. 112 healthy (70 DOGE, 22 SUI, 19 SOL, 1 AVAX). 0 perm-sig. Low absolute ROC as a consolidation filter is conceptually similar to compression but weaker — ROC measures price change magnitude, not volatility structure. Redundant with but inferior to VolReg.

rejected.name: Range Expansion Breakout
rejected.reason: Part of 12,528 configs (Range+ADX+BB). 0 healthy. Detecting when bar range exceeds N-bar average doesn't predict continuation. Expansion is descriptive (what just happened) not predictive (what will happen).

rejected.name: ADX Regime Filter
rejected.reason: Part of 12,528 configs. 0 healthy. ADX > threshold as a trend filter produces no edge. ADX is a lagging indicator — by the time ADX confirms a strong trend, the easy gains are over.

rejected.name: Bollinger Bandwidth Squeeze
rejected.reason: Part of 12,528 configs. 0 healthy. BB bandwidth squeeze corr with VolReg = 0.779 (DOGE), 0.729 (SOL), 0.675 (SUI). Essentially identical to VolReg compression measured differently. Bollinger uses rolling std of close prices which is the same input as VolReg. Even more redundant than Parkinson (r=0.87 with ATR).

rejected.name: Volume-Price Divergence
rejected.reason: Part of 7,344 configs (VolPrice+RSI+Body). 0 healthy. Volume-price divergence (high volume with low price change or vice versa) has no predictive power in 4H crypto. Volume information alone does not forecast direction.

rejected.name: RSI Regime
rejected.reason: Part of 7,344 configs. 0 healthy. RSI as regime filter (overbought/oversold thresholds) produces no edge. Oscillator-based signals fail in trending crypto markets — RSI can stay overbought/oversold for extended periods.

rejected.name: Candle Body Ratio
rejected.reason: Part of 7,344 configs. 0 healthy. Body ratio (real body / full range) is independent from ATR (r=0.163) and VolReg, measuring intrabar structure. However, individual bar morphology has no predictive power — independence does not equal utility.

rejected.name: Volume Clustering
rejected.reason: Part of 12,528 configs (VolCluster+MeanRev+RelVol). 0 healthy. Low volume compression (vol vs price_vol corr 0.50-0.66) does not predict direction. Volume is a liquidity proxy, not a volatility proxy.

rejected.name: Mean-Reversion Extreme
rejected.reason: Part of 12,528 configs. 0 healthy. Fading 2σ+ moves gated by vol compression produces no edge. Crypto trends are too persistent even in low-vol regimes for mean-reversion to work at 4H.

rejected.name: Relative Volume Breakout
rejected.reason: Part of 12,528 configs. 0 healthy. Volume surges (>2x median) with price breakout show no continuation edge. High volume can signal exhaustion just as easily as continuation.

rejected.name: Autocorrelation / OU Half-Life / Directional Accuracy / Price Acceleration
rejected.reason: 1,188 configs across 4 families. 0 perm-significant, 0 multi-symbol healthy. Autocorrelation: IS→OOS reversal (IS 0.31→OOS -1.06). OU Half-Life: SUI/SOL OOS bias, DOGE p=0.106. DirAccuracy: best p=0.144. PriceAccel: extreme IS overfit (IS 1.85→OOS -0.03). Serial dependence, mean-reversion speed, trend consistency, and momentum acceleration all fail on 4H crypto.

rejected.name: Garman-Klass Vol Compression
rejected.reason: Part of 22,032 configs (GK+VR+CrossTF). 0 healthy. GK uses all OHLC components but correlates r=0.80 with VolReg and r=0.88 with ATR. Volatility information in OHLCV converges to one dimension.

rejected.name: Variance Ratio Regime
rejected.reason: Part of 22,032 configs. 0 healthy. VR(q) ≈ 1 in 4H crypto — deviations too small for stable regime detection.

rejected.name: Cross-TF VolReg (Daily→4H)
rejected.reason: Part of 22,032 configs. 0 healthy. Daily compression signal degrades when propagated to 4H bars. Single-timeframe is superior.

rejected.name: Price Pattern Regime
rejected.reason: Part of 15,120 configs (Pattern+Funding+Expansion). 0 healthy. Inside bar + narrow range bar counting is binary and less informative than continuous std ratio.

rejected.name: Funding Rate Timing
rejected.reason: Part of 15,120 configs. 0 healthy. Trading around MEXC 8H funding settlement has no systematic edge. Timing alone is insufficient.

rejected.name: VolReg Symbol Expansion (XRP/ETH/ADA/LINK)
rejected.reason: 9,288 configs across 4 new symbols. 0 healthy on ANY symbol. CRITICAL: VolReg compression edge is DOGE/SOL/SUI/AVAX specific — does not generalize to more liquid/institutional coins. Edge is symbol-specific, not universal.

rejected.name: Wavelet Energy Ratio
rejected.reason: 4,320 configs (1,440×3 SLTP), 0 healthy. Simple DWT-inspired decomposition measures detail/approx energy ratio. Moderate correlation with VolReg (r=0.34-0.50) — somewhat independent but zero predictive power. Wavelet decomposition at 4H resolution cannot extract useful frequency information from OHLCV data.

rejected.name: Renko Regime
rejected.reason: 4,320 configs (1,440×3 SLTP), 0 healthy. Synthetic renko bricks with direction consistency measurement. Renko-based regime detection adds nothing beyond raw trend following — the brick construction loses information without gaining signal.

rejected.name: ZScore Momentum
rejected.reason: 4,320 configs (1,440×3 SLTP), 0 healthy. Self-normalizing z-score of N-bar returns. Pure momentum signal cannot overcome cost on 4H — yet another confirmation that trend-following alone is insufficient without a compression gate.

rejected.name: Intrabar Gap
rejected.reason: 576 configs, 0 healthy. Intrabar gap (open vs prev close) cannot detect actionable quiet-market periods. 4H timeframe gaps are too small and noisy.

rejected.name: Volatility Cone
rejected.reason: 3,888 configs, 890 'healthy' (22.89%) BUT uses cooldown_bars instead of max_hold_bars — positions held indefinitely until SL/TP. NOT comparable to 6 survivors. Top OOS Sharpe 4.205 (SUI). VolCone indicator correlates r=0.535 with VolReg — moderate overlap. Triple-window percentile compression is a variant of vol compression, NOT a new dimension. Requires re-validation with standardized max_hold_bars before promotion. PENDING REVALIDATION.

rejected.name: Compression Duration
rejected.reason: 5,184 configs, 342 'healthy' (6.6%) BUT same cooldown_bars issue as VolCone. Top OOS Sharpe 2.934 (AVAX). CompDur measures consecutive compression bars — adds 'time' dimension to vol compression. Same re-validation needed. PENDING REVALIDATION.

rejected.name: Conditional Volatility (Asymmetric Vol)
rejected.reason: 2,592 configs, 0 healthy. GARCH-like asymmetric vol (neg_vol/pos_vol ratio). VolRegとの相関 r=0.01-0.09 — 真に独立だが予測力ゼロ。レバレッジ効果は暗号資産4Hでは方向予測に変換されない。独立性≠有用性の最強証拠。

rejected.name: Markov Regime (Transition Probability)
rejected.reason: 2,916 configs, 0 healthy. Rolling calm→calm transition probability. 2-state Markov-like regime detection cannot capture exploitable structure. P(calm→calm)は圧縮の持続性を測定するが、VolReg/CompDurとは異なるアプローチでも結果は同じ。

rejected.name: Intrabar Pressure (Buying/Selling)
rejected.reason: 2,268 configs, 0 healthy. (C-O)/(H-L)の方向的買い/売り圧力 + 連続蓄積。Body Ratio (r=0.16 vs ATR)の方向拡張版だが同じく予測力なし。

rejected.name: Rolling Cointegration (Pairs Trading)
rejected.reason: 3,888 configs (6 pairs × 648 params), 0 healthy. Rolling OLS beta + z-score spread. Pairs trading fails on highly correlated alt pairs — spread mean-reversion is too weak to overcome trading costs. These alts move together but not in a cointegrated way.

rejected.name: Transfer Entropy (BTC→ALT)
rejected.reason: 2,592 configs, 0 healthy. Discretized TE measures BTC→ALT information flow. Transfer entropy estimates are too noisy at 4H resolution with small bins. Even when BTC is 'predictive' of ALTs (high TE), the prediction is too weak for cost-after profitability.

rejected.name: Realized Momentum (Vol-Adjusted)
rejected.reason: 3,024 configs, 0 healthy. Return/vol ratio (mini rolling Sharpe). Even with compression gate, vol-adjusted momentum alone cannot generate edge. This confirms that compression DETECTION is necessary but the DIRECTION component needs to be the simple EMA crossover — more sophisticated direction signals don't help.

rejected.name: Calendar Time (Day-of-Week/Hour)
rejected.reason: カレンダー効果（曜日・時間帯フィルター）は暗号資産24/7市場では一貫したエッジなし。

rejected.name: Autocorrelation Persistence
rejected.reason: Rolling自己相関レジーム（高/低持続性）は計算コストが非常に高い（5h40m実行）にもかかわらず0 healthy。4Hバーの自己相関推定はサンプルサイズ不足でノイジーすぎる。

rejected.name: Donchian Compression
rejected.reason: Donchian Channel幅の圧縮検出。VolReg r=0.47-0.58, ATR r=0.47-0.57 — 中程度の相関。圧縮ファミリーの別実装だが、VolReg/ATRより低い感度で劣る。

rejected.name: Dispersion Entropy (DispEn)
rejected.reason: 42,768 configs中DispEn分の約14,000 configs, 0 healthy。SampEnとの相関 r=0.57-0.72（中〜高）— やや冗長。量子化ビニングによるパターン分散エントロピーはSampEnのテンプレートマッチングに劣る。複雑性尺度ファミリーでSampEnのみが有効。

rejected.name: Regime Duration (Compression Persistence Meta)
rejected.reason: 連続圧縮バー数をメタ特徴として使用。CompDurに類似だがEMAゲートが異なる。0 healthy。圧縮の「持続時間」は有効な追加次元ではない。

rejected.name: Multi-TF Momentum (Daily+4H)
rejected.reason: 日足トレンド + 4H圧縮 + 4H EMAアライメントの3層フィルター。0 healthy。Cross-TF VolRegと同様に、異なる時間足の情報統合は4Hコスト構造下で機能しない。

rejected.name: Weekend Effect
rejected.reason: 14 healthy だがperm p>0.05（最良p=0.06 SOL, p=0.078）。24/7市場でも参加者構成が週末に変化する可能性あるが統計的に有意ではない。

rejected.name: Session Volume Profile
rejected.reason: 0 healthy。時間帯別リターンパターンはCalendar効果と同じく暗号資産では一貫性なし。

rejected.name: Volume Momentum Exhaustion
rejected.reason: 14,736 configs中一部, 弱い結果。ボリューム加重モメンタム消耗は理論的には面白いが4Hで方向予測力不足。

rejected.name: Range Contraction After Expansion
rejected.reason: ATRスパイク後の収縮は検出可能だが、VolReg圧縮と概念的に重複。独立したエッジなし。

rejected.name: Close-Position Vol Compression
rejected.reason: バー内クローズポジション+圧縮ゲート。Intrabar Pressureの変種。2 perm-sig あるがWEAK判定。

rejected.name: Regime-Adaptive Ensemble
rejected.reason: 29,160 configs (3 modes: volreg_plus_trend, volreg_only_trend_filter, compression_or_trend). 0 healthy. Ensemble combination of compression + trend signals does not improve over individual signals. Overly complex gating reduces signal density without improving quality.

rejected.name: VolReg Meme Expansion (PEPE/WIF/BONK)
rejected.reason: Part of 29,160 configs. 0 healthy on any meme coin. PEPE/WIF/BONK have too short a history and too extreme volatility for compression edge to manifest. VolReg compression edge requires minimum data history for regime boundaries.

rejected.name: VolReg L1 Expansion (NEAR/APT/SEI)
rejected.reason: Part of 29,160 configs. 0 healthy. NEAR/APT/SEI do not exhibit the same compression→breakout dynamics as DOGE/SUI/SOL/AVAX. Confirms VolReg edge is token-specific — high-beta meme-adjacent coins with retail-driven vol structure.

rejected.name: Vol Smile Skew (Weekend Filter)
rejected.reason: 160 configs, 14 healthy, 0 perm-significant. Weekend vol skew patterns not statistically significant.
